editorial:
You're in for a wild ride with this action-packed thriller about a framed security expert who must save his family from a burning skyscraper. Dwayne Johnson plays Will Sawyer, who gets blamed for a massive fire in the world's tallest building. With his family trapped inside, he has to climb, fight, and outsmart the bad guys. The movie moves fast and keeps you on the edge of your seat from start to finish, with big stunts and tense moments that make you hold your breath.

The action scenes are the real star here, especially the jaw-dropping moments where Will jumps between buildings and climbs the outside of the tower. Dwayne Johnson brings his usual charm, making you root for him the whole time. The pacing rarely slows down, which is great for nonstop excitement, but it can feel over the top at times. The story is simple and predictable, so don't expect deep surprises. If you love big, dumb fun action movies, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: Will learns the fire was no accident. A terrorist named Botha set it to steal a drive holding criminal evidence from the building's owner. Will's wife Sarah fights back inside and helps their kids escape. In the final showdown, Will faces Botha on the rooftop as the building crumbles. He manages to save his family and stop Botha for good. The twist is that the whole attack was planned to grab the hidden drive, not just destroy the tower. In the end, Will and his family make it out alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action movies and Dwayne Johnson.
